title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.31179v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As AI agents become increasingly capable of complex, long-horizon reasoning, rigorous evaluation is essential for measuring progress toward real-world healthcare applications. However, existing healthcare benchmarks are often static or narrow in clinical scope, motivating broader evaluation of agents acting on raw patient data. We introduce HealthAgentBench, a suite of 75 agentic healthcare tasks across 9 categories each with its unique environment. The benchmark suite spans diagnosis, specimen assessment, research, and data management workflows and a broad range of modalities. Each task is designed to replicate an end-to-end clinical workflow: given task instructions and supporting resources, an agent must explore raw healthcare data, operate within a complex environment, and execute multi-step solutions that go beyond naive prompting, such as querying large clinical databases or interpreting gigapixel pathology images. translated_title: HealthAgentBench：用于挑战前沿AI智能体的统一真实智能体医疗环境基准套件
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体在复杂、长程推理方面的能力日益增强，严格的评估对于衡量其在真实世界医疗应用方面的进展至关重要。然而，现有的医疗基准往往是静态的或临床范围狭窄，这促使人们需要更广泛地评估智能体处理原始患者数据的能力。我们提出了HealthAgentBench，这是一个包含75个智能体医疗任务的基准套件，涵盖9个类别，每个类别都有其独特的环境。该基准套件涵盖诊断、标本评估、研究和数据管理工作流程，以及广泛的模态。每个任务都旨在复制端到端的临床工作流程：在给定任务说明和支持资源的情况下，智能体必须探索原始医疗数据，在复杂环境中进行操作，并执行超越简单提示的多步骤解决方案，例如查询大型临床数据库或解读千兆像素病理图像。
tldr: 该论文提出了HealthAgentBench，一个包含75个智能体医疗任务、涵盖9个类别且各具独特环境的统一基准套件，通过模拟端到端临床工作流程，评估AI智能体在真实医疗场景中处理原始数据并执行复杂多步骤任务的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces HealthAgentBench, a unified benchmark suite of 75 agentic healthcare tasks across 9 categories with unique environments, designed to evaluate AI agents' ability to explore raw patient data and execute complex multi-step solutions in realistic end-to-end clinical workflows.
